title: Hourly trainer-VM dispatch of schedule-keeper.yml (backstop clock independent of GitHub's scheduler)
note: [manager 2026-11-01a] Measured (FORECAST-GRADE lane, 48h to 14:25Z): schedule-keeper cron fired 13 of ~56 expected; kept alive only by bot pushes; max gap between completed runs 73.3 min, under every target's stale window. Operator popup ~14:48Z, verbatim: 'Yes, BRANCH_PROTECTION_TOKEN'. Lane build refused twice by the auto-mode classifier; operator (verbatim excerpt) 'I took you off auto mode because that is the sanctioned first path for dealing with these kinds of permission issues. You can ask for permission and I will grant it.' Built by the manager. After merge: vm-git-credential-bootstrap target trainer, credential dispatch; observe HTTP 204 and a keeper run created by the dispatch. 2026-11-01T17:27Z OBSERVED (issue #22216, run 41328376552): /etc/ict/gh-dispatch.env root:root 600; ict-keeper-dispatch.timer installed (:23 UTC hourly); first run logged 'keeper-dispatch: dispatched schedule-keeper.yml (HTTP 204)'; schedule-keeper workflow_dispatch runs 41330835157 (17:18:53Z, first run) and 41331268774 (17:24:02Z, timer) both appeared. Merged #22191 = deployed = observed. 2026-11-16 22:20Z: trainer-capture-watch.yml (cron '23 */6 * * *') is NOT in scripts/ops/schedule_keeper.py TARGETS (0 matches) and its scheduled slots 12:23Z and 18:23Z on 2026-11-16 never appeared in its run list (last scheduled run 06:49Z, run 1674, success, receipt 06:59Z). Its liveness guard (check_trainer_capture_watch, window 15h) went red on every PR at ~21:50Z (15.4h). I dispatched it by workflow_dispatch at 22:14Z. GAP: a 6-hourly watcher that gates every PR via a receipt-age guard has no keeper backfill. Candidate fix (not built): add it to TARGETS with stale_hours ~8 and a dedupe job or self_dedupes (a graded run per slot is idempotent: it rewrites the receipt). Needs the keeper's test (tests/test_schedule_keeper.py) to pass.

observation.how_to_check: trainer journalctl -u ict-keeper-dispatch.service | grep keeper-dispatch: ; Actions runs of schedule-keeper.yml event=workflow_dispatch
observation.what: one ict-keeper-dispatch run on the trainer logs HTTP 204 and a schedule-keeper.yml run with event workflow_dispatch appears within a minute
